facts.text: Trimper's Rides, founded in 1893, is Ocean City's oldest amusement park, still drawing crowds on the historic boardwalk.
The first Ocean City boardwalk, originally called Atlantic Avenue, was constructed in 1902 and still stretches from the inlet to 27th Street.
The 1912 Herschell‑Spillman carousel, nicknamed 'The Pride of the Boardwalk,' earned the National Carousel Association's Historic Carousel Award in 1996.
In 2022, Ocean City launched the Oceans Calling Festival, a four‑day music event featuring acts like Dave Matthews Band and Cyndi Lauper.
During summer, Ocean City swells to become Maryland's second‑most populated municipality after Baltimore, a surge that attracts over 1,000 seasonal police officers.
The Ocean City Film Festival, held each March, showcases independent films and has become a staple of the town's cultural calendar.
